title: Miso Soup with Tofu and Spring Onion Rice
summary: A light Japanese breakfast of savoury miso soup with soft tofu and spring onion, served with steamed rice. It’s warm, simple, and gently umami-rich.
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then cook it with about 300 ml water until tender and fluffy.
While the rice cooks, bring the remaining water to a gentle simmer in a small saucepan with the garlic and ginger.
Lower the heat and whisk in the miso until dissolved; do not let the soup boil.
Add the tofu cubes and simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes, just until warmed through.
Stir in most of the spring onion and the sesame oil, then taste and add a pinch of salt only if needed.
Serve the miso soup hot in bowls with the steamed rice on the side, topped with the remaining spring onion.
